incident.symptom: Authenticated mobile chat returned Pandora intelligence is temporarily unavailable with HTTP 503.
rootCauses: The earlier Bedrock synchronous SQL bridge inserted a one-time ticket and called Vercel before the transaction committed, so the external claim could not see the ticket and returned BEDROCK_CHAT_TICKET_CLAIM_FAILED.

Gemini runtime credential drift existed: the live Worker-B broker had been altered to Gemini_api3 instead of canonical gemini_api_key. Gemini_api3 returned 401 because its bound service account is disabled/deleted; canonical gemini_api_key returned 403 because the Google project is denied access.
OpenRouter was not usable and its routing_eligible flag was fenced false; OpenAI and Kimi were disabled.

durableLesson: Never re-enable or prefer a model provider from catalog/config presence alone. Require a current live inference probe and authoritative provider readback. For cross-service one-time tickets, commit issuance before external claim. Keep failed providers fenced and ensure bounded fallback lists preserve provider diversity.
